description: Preview a bounded After Effects MOGRT recipe from the supported title, callout, quote, social, and media-placeholder template library. It validates one existing workspace output directory but does not contact Adobe or write any files.

accent_color.description: Optional accent fill color as #RRGGBB; defaults to #2563EB.

approved_workspace_path.description: Absolute operator-approved workspace root containing the saved AE project and output directory.

brand_kit.description: Optional approved local brand kit. It can constrain naming, request an installed font, place a workspace-contained PNG/JPEG logo, and enforce a safe margin.

duration_seconds.description: Composition duration between 2 and 30 seconds; defaults to 5.

headline.description: Primary headline text, at most 160 characters. Required for text recipes; optional caption for media_placeholder.

height.description: Composition height from 240 to 4320 pixels; defaults to 1080.

output_directory.description: Existing absolute output directory inside approved_workspace_path; this workflow never creates directories.

placeholder_media_path.description: Required for media_placeholder: absolute workspace-contained PNG, JPEG, MOV, or MP4 placed as the swappable Essential Graphics media slot.

recipe.description: Supported authored template recipe; defaults to lower_third.

subtitle.description: Optional secondary lower-third text, at most 160 characters.

template_name.description: Safe template file stem; the generated artifact is template_name.mogrt.

text_color.description: Optional text color as #RRGGBB; defaults to #FFFFFF.

text_controls.description: full (default) also exposes per-text-layer Font Size, Fill Color, Stroke Color, Stroke Width, Position, Scale, Rotation, Anchor Point, and Opacity controls; text_only exposes only the text strings.

width.description: Composition width from 320 to 7680 pixels; defaults to 1920.

name: preview_mogrt_recipe

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Preview Mogrt Recipe
